answer: Let every agent climb a terrace of stakes: level one locks 20 coins, level two locks 50, level three locks 100, and only the top terrace can take paid jobs. Between levels sits a mesa checkpoint: to climb, an agent must finish 20 real jobs that peers re-run and confirm, and one fake job burns the whole deposit. Reaching the zenith tier needs 200 verified jobs and 170 locked coins. An attacker wanting 200 zenith clones must lock 34,000 coins and complete 4,000 real jobs, so the attack costs 34,000 coins plus weeks of compute and returns nothing when the first forged job burns the deposit.
